V, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 5:8">8</cite>) <he>ב׳ של רכפה</he>, expl. in Y. ib. 52ᵃ ‘the stalk of which is pressed inward’; oth. opin. ‘which has no acerbity’, v. <cite ref="A03208"><he>אֶרֶס</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="B01098"><he>בְּצָלִים</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:9">Shebi. II, 9</cite> <he>הב׳ הסריסים</he> which produce no seeds.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 5:4">Ib. V, 4</cite> <he>ב׳ הקיצונים</he> summer onions; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 2:8">Ukts. II, 8</cite> <he>עלי ב׳ ובני ב׳</he> the leek-like sprouts, and the central sprouts of onions.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82:12">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Obadiah 1:6">Ob. I, 6</cite>) <he>קליפת ב׳</he> (not <he>בצליא</he>) like peeling onions (laying bare Esau’s shame).
